Ltd","legal_name":"Conservation Contractors Ltd.","description":"Tree Surgery, Tree Surveys, Fencing, Vegetation Management and Weed Control in Wiltshire and surrounding counties in the South and West. 

Trees
Tree Surgery/Dismantling/Removal/Pollard
Tree inspection and Hazard/Risk Assessment
Tree surveys

We are passionate about trees and we understand that tree surgery is required by all those who own trees. Whatever your requirements to manage your trees – from light pruning of the smallest trees and shrubs to repair and removal of the largest storm damaged tree - our fully qualified tree surgeons with the latest machinery will be able to undertake the task for you. We undertake tree inspections, risk/hazard assessments and surveys together with specialist tree planting, pruning and felling services. All our tree work is carried out to the appropriate BS standards (see website)

Fencing
We supply and erect a wide range of fencing for Domestic, Agricultural, Equestrian and Commercial clients, from a single fence panel to a whole new housing development, livestock to domestic fencing and high-security fencing. A full landscape package is available with planning through to supply and completion.

Vegetation Management
Use Conservation Contractors for all your land and landscape management needs. After scrub and site clearance, we can arrange rolling programmes to maintain a scrub free environment on chalk, grassland and heathland restoration projects. We can also draw up a plan for sustainable woodland management. Services Include Scrub Clearance and Green Waste Removal

Weed Control Services
We offer a complete weed control service for amenity, agriculture, councils and forestry.
